configurations.name: controltower-demo
runtimeArgs: . ~/.nvm/nvm.sh >/dev/null 2>&1; nvm use 24 >/dev/null 2>&1; cd server && CT_DEMO=1 CT_PORT=4000 CT_DATA_DIR=../data/demo CT_LOG_LEVEL=info npx tsx src/main.ts

configurations.name: controltower
runtimeArgs: . ~/.nvm/nvm.sh >/dev/null 2>&1; nvm use 24 >/dev/null 2>&1; cd server && CT_PORT=4000 CT_DATA_DIR=../data/dev CT_LOG_LEVEL=info npx tsx src/main.ts

configurations.name: controltower-load
runtimeArgs: . ~/.nvm/nvm.sh >/dev/null 2>&1; nvm use 24 >/dev/null 2>&1; CT_PORT=4600 CT_DATA_DIR=data/load CT_ADMIN_KEY=load-test-admin-key-0123456789 CT_UI_DIR=ui/dist CT_LOG_LEVEL=warn node server/dist/server.mjs

configurations.name: controltower-check
runtimeArgs: . ~/.nvm/nvm.sh >/dev/null 2>&1; nvm use 24 >/dev/null 2>&1; CT_PORT=4610 CT_DATA_DIR=data/check-$(date +%s) CT_ADMIN_KEY=check-admin-key-0123456789 CT_UI_DIR=ui/dist CT_LOG_LEVEL=warn node server/dist/server.mjs
